title: Hazel and the Cellar
author: Odile Fairweather
blurb: Freya Amberdale, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
